title: Wow, you’re malignant…
body:
So, you broke functionality and ditched support for the old ”classic” version I bought; to make this version -  that costs considerably more to purchase up-front, forcing people to instead ”subscribe”, putting money in your pocket on a monthly basis? That is disgusting. Absolutely vile.
A nasty business-model like this is a great way, both to slander yorself, and this product of yours…
I am disappointed.
author: Zkratt
